Product Description


The 2001 vintage of Talisker's Distillers Edition, which is double matured, with the finish taking place in Amoroso casks, similar in style to sweet oloroso sherry. This adds sweetness and extra fruitiness to the smoke.

25 May 2018


Michael Davidson



This drink came out amongst others for my 50th birthday celebration. My whisky loving friends came up from London with their girls and we bought ten different single malts. The girls poured the drinks and kept each bottle a secret. We graded each dram for fun. Eight out of ten of us marked this as our number one. It pipped two much pricier Macallans to get top place too!!! I got to keep the rest of this bottle. Needless to say it didn’t last long. Another already in the cupboard.

This is in my opinion the epitome of a Talisker malt. Sweet, Salty, lingering medicine tones of peat. This in my opinion. Having been to Skye is the best offering that is Affordable from this distillery.
